A species of '''flat-backed beasts''' with carapaces that inhabited the rivers on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] a [[planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] rode these beasts around the water ways.<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel" />

Between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Galen Marek]] used the force to attract a member of the species. After connecting with its mind Marek considered it [[Sentience/Legends|semisentient]] at best and used it to traverse part of Felucia during his [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|mission]] to hunt down [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Sean Williams]]<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel" /> of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' developed and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
